## VantaVault v0.5.31

Replay every round of a match, see where fights are won and lost on the map, and stay signed in to your saved accounts for longer.

### Highlights
- **Round review with replay**: Pick any round to see everyone's position at each kill, the shot line, the kill feed with agent and weapon icons, and the turning points.
- **Trade range on the map**: Open one of your deaths to see the 10 m trade range, your nearest teammate, how far the killer was and whether you were traded.
- **Takeaways you can see**: Short notes on what to work on and what to keep doing, each one shown on the map when you select it.

### Added
- Zoom the match map: scroll to zoom, drag to move, or use the + / − / Fit buttons. Markers keep their size.
- Filter map fights by attack or defense, with a win–loss record for each side in every area.
- Biggest change after the side swap: the area where your fights went most differently between halves.
- A top-bar update button that fills with download progress and shows what's new before you restart.

### Improved
- Round review uses a slimmer header so the rounds and map get more space.
- Deathmatch and other single-round modes show the whole match as one timeline.
- Kill and death markers on the map are crisp instead of glowing.
- Saved accounts renew every 6 hours while VantaVault runs, including from the tray. Turn on Launch at Login to keep them signed in.

### Fixed
- Updates are found on startup and every 6 hours, download in the background and install on restart.
- The portable build no longer starts its old version again or offers the same update twice.
- A brief Riot hiccup while renewing an account is retried instead of signing you out.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe` — run directly with no setup.
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.31_x64-setup.exe` — optional per-user installation.

### Auto-update
Both Windows release types update from inside VantaVault. Android debug and signed builds are produced through the repository workflows and are not published on Google Play.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.30...v0.5.31
